en.label: Repetition / reinforcement
en.definition: The compared structures repeat a similar elemental or branch quality, increasing structural recurrence without implying a good or bad outcome.

zh-Hans.label: 重复／强化
zh-Hans.definition: 比较结构重复相近的元素或地支性质，表示结构性重复增加，不代表吉凶结果。

en.label: Outgoing support flow
en.definition: The source structure generates the target element, describing a directed resource or support flow.

zh-Hans.label: 向外支持流
zh-Hans.definition: 来源结构生助目标元素，描述有方向的资源或支持流。

en.label: Incoming support flow
en.definition: The source structure is generated by the target element, describing incoming resource or support.

zh-Hans.label: 承接支持流
zh-Hans.definition: 来源结构受到目标元素生助，描述进入的资源或支持。

en.label: Outgoing structuring pressure
en.definition: The source structure controls the target element, describing constraint or structuring pressure exerted outward.

zh-Hans.label: 向外约束／塑形
zh-Hans.definition: 来源结构制约目标元素，描述向外施加的约束或塑形压力。

en.label: Incoming constraint pressure
en.definition: The source structure is controlled by the target element, describing constraint or pressure received.

zh-Hans.label: 承受约束压力
zh-Hans.definition: 来源结构受到目标元素制约，描述承受的约束或压力。

en.label: Coordination / integration tendency
en.definition: A governed stem or branch combination is present, describing a structural tendency toward coordination or integration without predicting an event.

zh-Hans.label: 协调／整合倾向
zh-Hans.definition: 出现受治理的天干或地支合，描述结构上的协调或整合倾向，不预测事件。

en.label: Friction / reorientation
en.definition: A governed branch clash is present, describing structural friction or pressure for reorientation without predicting an event.

zh-Hans.label: 摩擦／重新定向
zh-Hans.definition: 出现受治理的地支冲，描述结构摩擦或重新定向压力，不预测具体事件。
